title: Ladder Filter - Band 41 (2500 MHz TDD) for GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter
subtitle: Design Validation and Performance Characterization
author: Dr. Olaf Bergstrom

sections.1_OBJECTIVE: This document describes the design, simulation, and characterization of a Ladder Filter filter targeting Band 41 (2500 MHz TDD) for GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter. The filter is designed on Langasite substrate with a target center frequency of 3854.0 MHz and bandwidth of 79.2 MHz. The objective is to validate that the filter meets the required insertion loss, rejection, and linearity specifications for integration into the GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter module. This design iteration addresses feedback from the previous revision regarding out-of-band rejection improvements and temperature stability.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Filter Type: Ladder Filter
- Frequency Band: Band 41 (2500 MHz TDD)
- Application: GPS/GNSS Anti-Jamming Filter
- Substrate: Langasite
- Package: SiP (System in Package)
- Design Tool: PathWave EM Design
- Design Center: Newbury Park Design Center

This specification applies to all variants of the Ladder Filter design targeting Band 41 (2500 MHz TDD). Results are used to qualify the design for mass production release.
sections.3_DESIGN_PARAMETERS:
Center Frequency:       3854.0 MHz
Bandwidth (3 dB):       79.2 MHz
Insertion Loss Target:  <= 2.1 dB
Return Loss Target:     >= 12.0 dB
Out-of-Band Rejection:  >= 43.0 dB
Isolation (Duplexer):   >= 29.0 dB
Q Factor:               13606
Temperature Coefficient:-27.9 ppm/°C
Die Size:               2.7 x 0.6 mm
Wafer Size:             6-inch
Number of Resonators:   5
Electrode Material:     Al
Passivation:            Si3N4
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Open PathWave EM Design and load the Ladder Filter template project.
2. Define the substrate stack: Langasite with specified layer thicknesses.
3. Set design targets: center freq 3854.0 MHz, BW 79.2 MHz.
4. Run initial EM simulation with 2D mesh density of 20 cells/wavelength.
5. Optimize resonator geometry using gradient descent (target IL < 2.1 dB).
6. Verify coupling coefficients between resonator stages.
7. Run 3D FEM simulation to account for package parasitics (SiP (System in Package)).
8. Export GDS-II layout for mask fabrication.
9. Fabricate prototype wafers (6-inch, Langasite).
10. Perform on-wafer probing using Anritsu MS46122B ShockLine.
11. Measure S-parameters (S11, S21, S12, S22) from 100 MHz to 11562 MHz.
12. Compare measured results against simulation and specification limits.
13. Perform temperature cycling (-40°C to +85°C) and re-measure.
14. Document results and generate summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Insertion loss at center frequency shall be <= 2.1 dB
- Return loss in passband shall be >= 12.0 dB
- Out-of-band rejection at +/- 119 MHz offset >= 43.0 dB
- Group delay variation across passband shall be <= 4 ns
- Temperature drift over -40°C to +85°C shall be <= 13.4 MHz
- Power handling shall be >= +35 dBm at 1 dB compression
- ESD tolerance >= 500 V (HBM)
- Die yield on qualification lot >= 97%
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Measurement Date:       2024-06-16
Devices Tested:         68
Insertion Loss (meas):  1.82 dB
Return Loss (meas):     14.4 dB
Rejection (meas):       46.2 dB
Isolation (meas):       34.1 dB
Q Factor (meas):        13606
Group Delay Variation:  1.1 ns
Power Handling:         +33 dBm
Die Yield:              86.3%

Result Classification:  FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Ladder Filter design demonstrated below-target performance for Band 41 (2500 MHz TDD).
b) Insertion loss met target specification.
c) Out-of-band rejection exceeded the minimum requirement.
d) Group delay flatness improved compared to previous revision.
e) Batch-to-batch reproducibility confirmed over 3 wafer lots.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
1. Optimize resonator geometry to reduce insertion loss by ~0.3 dB.
2. Re-run EM simulation with refined mesh for better accuracy.
3. Escalate to advanced materials team for alternative piezoelectric stack.
